text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I lost~~! Seriously the worst!! Total 
disaster! I'm super bummed out~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No... I'm just so freakin' weak... It's 
honestly hilarious... All I can do is 
laugh."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: We still have a move to make!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What is that supposed to mean...? What am 
I supposed to do, then? If you give me 
some half-assed answer, I'm gonna be mad.

"I broke down the reasons for the loss in 
today's race and the areas to improve. If 
we do it right, we'll definitely be able 
to win next time..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, c'mon! Stop, stop! I can't understand 
anything when you're all yammering at 
once!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, meet up on the track once we get 
back, 'kay~☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Liiike I said, teach me while we're 
moving. I get that you're putting a ton of 
thought into this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We're startin' the minute we get back to 
the academy. Don't be late, got it~~~?

It seems Tosen Jordan regained her 
motivation in her own way. Afterward, we 
got in a solid training session together.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We're running to win, right? Both you and 
I are working our butts off for that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I can't think of myself as cool unless I 
come in first place!
choice_data_list: Then let's win in style next time!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Obviously. There's no way I'm gonna go out 
looking lame.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna show ya some 
seriously insane runnin'. I will 
def-i-nite-ly win!
